remarks: Ideally situated in the pulse of the desirable Noroton, one of Darien's most popular neighborhoods, walking distance to the train, grocery, new restaurants + shops, this enchanting, open & updated single family home offers 3-4 bedrooms (including a 1st floor bedroom option), 2-full baths, open kitchen/dining/family room, formal living room with fireplace, 2-car garage, central air, large & level fenced back lawn with patio and front porch for outdoor relaxation and enjoyment. This property is pet friendly. Good credentials are a must!
